dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. How may I help?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I've heard that you contributed greatly to the rebuilding of the Jade Chamber and to the relatively small amount of damage that Liyue Harbor suffered at the hands of our ocean-borne enemy. You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Please enjoy the Lantern Rite for the duration of your stay.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: And you are...? For civil matters, please go to the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have some questions.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Please, ask away! I will answer to the best of my ability.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Oh? I take it that you are not from around here, then.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Not that there's any problem with that, we do not exclude anybody here in Liyue! On the contrary, with this being a commercial port, people get nervous if they see a decline in the foreign population.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Thanks to the guidance of Rex Lapis, Liyue has gone from strength to strength in the last thousand years.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Our forebears discovered the craft of producing glazes via firing. Trade with foreign lands grew, and Liyue prospered.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Our biggest point of pride is that Mora, the coins used as currency throughout Teyvat, are cast right here in Liyue at the Golden House. More importantly, Mora are named after Morax, which is Rex Lapis' original name.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: You could say the Qixing are my bosses... Surely it doesn't count as workplace gossip if I'm just giving you their backstories? Haha...

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: The Qixing — or "Seven Stars" — is a Liyue business committee. It is also used as a collective term for the seven business tycoons who sit on the committee and handle Liyue's government affairs.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: I trust you have heard of Ningguang, of the Jade Chamber? Like her, each Qixing is a major player in business circles whose every action has a profound influence.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: They are responsible for implementing the policy that comes down from Rex Lapis and making rulings on important matters. They are akin to the hands and feet of Rex Lapis.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Could you tell me a bit more about the Qixing?

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Hmm, the Qixing do in fact have a clear internal division of labor.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Besides Lady Ningguang, with whom you are familiar, the Yuheng, Lady Keqing, is in charge of land, construction works and the like.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Liyue is very vast, and requires strict regulation and eminent developmental direction...

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: The other esteemed members of the Qixing are also highly accomplished in their own fields. They are the pillars of the prosperity that Liyue enjoys today.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: We are at Yuehai Pavilion. This is where the Qixing discuss official business and rule on major issues that affect the whole of Liyue.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: To serve the Qixing is to serve all of Liyue, so it is my honor to be working here.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Sometimes I feel like the whole way I carry myself has become more dignified since I started working here. Hehehe.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: None of the big shots are here right now — presumably they're all busy with private business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Bye. Good luck with everything.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. I wasn't expecting visitors at this time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Yuehai Pavilion is closed at the moment. I like to come here when there is no business to attend to, to stretch my legs and think about things.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: There is so much that is inscrutable in this world... The seasonal rhythm of the monsoons, the nature of Celestia, destiny itself... and what goes on inside other people's heads...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I do wonder what goes on in the minds of the Qixing...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Surely the Geo Archon isn't...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Bye. Mind your step in the dark.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Now that we've sent Rex Lapis off, we will never again receive his direction...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: ...That burden now falls upon the Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: But I don't fear for our future. Other than the Qixing, we do still have Ganyu. She'll do a great job supporting the Qixing, I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. How may I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have some questions.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Please, ask away! I will answer to the best of my ability.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Not that there's any problem with that, we do not exclude anybody here in Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: On the contrary, with this being a commercial port, people get nervous if they see a decline in the foreign population.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Thanks to the guidance of Rex Lapis, Liyue has gone from strength to strength in the last thousand years.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Our forebears discovered the craft of producing glazes via firing. Trade with foreign lands grew, and Liyue prospered.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Our biggest point of pride is that Mora, the coins used as currency throughout Teyvat, are cast right here in Liyue at the Golden House. More importantly, Mora are named after Morax, which is Rex Lapis' original name.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Hello, I am Huixin, Secretary of the Yuehai Pavilion. Serving Liyue is my duty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Donate Mingxiao Lantern Materials

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: You came all this way to donate materials for the lantern? Such dedication!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How is progress on the Mingxiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Thanks to the generous help of everyone in Liyue, work on the Mingxiao Lantern is now well underway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to know more about Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Ooh, if this your first Lantern Rite, I could be your guide?

choices.text: What is the Mingxiao Lantern for?

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Long, long ago, the heroes and the people joined forces to protect the land of Liyue.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Since peace was restored, the tradition of everyone coming together to build a giant floating lantern has been observed as a way of keeping that spirit of unity alive.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Everyone who can collects materials, donates what they can spare, and helps with the construction work. And on the final night of the festival, the whole city watches as the lantern is released into the air. It's the tradition most integral to Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Do you see the huge stone in the middle of the lantern? It's the largest Plaustrite unearthed this year.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: How big the Mingxiao Lantern is depends on the size of the biggest Plaustrite from the preceding year. This year is special, because it has the biggest chunk of Plaustrite found in twenty years.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: In honor of the great heroes who died to protect Liyue, the Mingxiao Lantern's design is always based on the adeptus form of one of the heroes.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern depicts the adeptus form of Skybracer. The Yuehai Pavilion chose the theme based on popular demand.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: To put it simply, it's one of the attractions for visitors to the festival.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: A substantial portion of the funding for the Mingxiao Lantern comes from vendors at the market.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: So although Liyue Harbor's business people can sometimes seem a little tight-fisted, when it comes down to it they're all good people.

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: While everyone's out for the festival, why not talk them, get to know them a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I just might! Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Goodbye. May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.
